name: File Browser
description: File Browser is a lightweight web-based file manager that lets you manage files on your host system directly from the browser. (Default credentials: admin / admin)
compose_template:
version: '3.8'

services:
  filebrowser:
    image: filebrowser/filebrowser:latest
    container_name: selfhost-filebrowser
    command: -d /database/filebrowser.db -b /files
    volumes:
      - {{DATA_DIR}}:/srv
      - {{APP_DATA_DIR}}/database:/database
      - {{APP_DATA_DIR}}/config:/config
    restart: unless-stopped

networks:
  default:
    name: selfhost-network
    external: true
